attribution_limitations: Source conflict: the article says detectable SARS-CoV-2 RNA in upper airway swabs lasted until day 25, whereas Supplementary Table 2 lists the last detectable swab (Ct 33.6) at Day 22 with Day 28 not detected, and Supplementary Data 1 (Fig 1c sheet) lists the same Ct value at day 24. The article fact and the supplement rows are review only. Do not choose a day.

The abstract states an initial increase in neutrophils and monocytes with depletion particularly of CD8 T and NK cells, whereas the Results state neutrophil and eosinophil proportions remained stable over the first 10 days, increasing at day 28, and that CD4 T, CD8 T, B and NK cells were all markedly reduced at day 10. Abstract wording is not stored as facts; the Results sentences are.

The Fig. 1B caption describes bilateral interstitial infiltrates with left lower lobe collapse and consolidation, whereas the Results describe peri-hilar interstitial and ground-glass opacities with left lower lobe collapse and small bilateral pleural effusions. Both are kept as separate statements; no reconciliation is made.

The PBMC comparison values and the Control columns in Fig. 2C to 2E and Fig. 3 belong to an age/sex-matched control infant who had undergone tetralogy of Fallot correction, not to the index patient; control values are not stored as patient facts.

Text values differ slightly from Supplementary Data 1: CD69 on CD4+ T cells after stimulation is 27.2% in the text and 27.1 in the Fig 3a sheet (a one-character difference), and the day 84 Th2 proportion is 28.2% in the text and 28 in the Fig 2d sheet (a rounding difference). Per the rules these are ambiguities, not source conflicts; the text values are stored and the sheet values stay in the supplement sidecar.

Author interpretations are hedged and not stored as causes: that early remdesivir, tocilizumab and dexamethasone (and/or natural history) correlated with a Th2-type cytokine shift, and that the prior cardiac history possibly made the infant more susceptible to severe disease.

The clinical timeline in Fig. 1A (symptom onset, IVIG, remdesivir, tocilizumab, dexamethasone and heparin spans, discharge, clinical follow-up) is image content recorded only in visual.json. Discharge and heparin duration are not stated in the text and are not stored as facts.

The source gives Day 0 as the intubation and intensive care day (Fig. 1A, Day 0) and describes serial time points as days following admission; the text does not state that Day 0 equals the day of hospital admission, so no anchor is attached to day-numbered times except where the sentence says "admission".

caption_claims.text: Fig. 2 Immune cell profiling in whole blood and PBMCs.A Flow cytometry was performed on whole blood samples collected at 3, 5, 10, 28, and 84 days following admission. Neutrophils, eosinophils, CD4 T cells, CD8 T cells, B cells, Natural Killer (NK) cells, monocytes (classical, intermediate, and non-classical), and dendritic cells were classified by manual gating and expressed as cells/µL using counting beads. B Unsupervised clustering and dimensionality reduction were performed using FlowSOM and UMAP on a concatenated file containing 150,000 live single cells (30,000 randomly selected cells from each time point). The UMAP plots at each time point are coloured according to the generated FlowSOM clusters. C Flow cytometry was performed on peripheral blood mononuclear cells collected on days 3, 5, 10, 28, and 84 following admission. CD4, CD8, γδVδ2+ T-cells, and MAIT cells were classified by manual gating and expressed as a frequency of CD3+ T-cells. These results were compared to an age/sex-matched control, obtained at a single time-point. D Subsets of CD4+ and CD8+ T-cells were further categorised by flow cytometry to determine the frequency of Th1, Th2, Th17, Treg, and memory subsets. These were expressed as the frequency of CD4+ or CD8+ T-cells. E Flow cytometry was performed to assess the activation status of T-cells. CD69+ was expressed as a proportion of total CD4+, CD8+, γδVδ2+ T-cells, and MAIT cells. F Cytokines were quantified in the serum using a multiplex cytokine assay and visualised in a heatmap containing log2 transformed values and clustered according to peak expression at day 3 (cluster 1), day 5 (cluster 2), day 10 (cluster 3), and day 28 (cluster 4). IL-18 levels at days 3, 5, 10, 28, and 84 were quantified by ELISA and expressed as pg/ml. UMAP Uniform Manifold Approximation and Projection, MAIT mucosal-associated invariant T cells.
